digest.component_or_area: bug ticket creation and event processing
propositions: Bug tickets lack metadata indicating which detection channel (canary, CI, review bot, human audit, user report) discovered them, preventing measurement of escape-channel trends.
A REBAR_DETECTED_BY environment variable set by automated filers and an optional --detected-by CLI flag must capture the detection source at ticket creation with zero user friction.

The detected_by value is normalized by strip() + lowercase, with empty/whitespace-only treated as unset; any non-empty value is stamped verbatim without enum enforcement, allowing new channels without code changes.
The detected_by field must be projected additively into compiled state and event streams by the reducer, such that tickets created without the field reduce byte-identically to pre-change behavior.

The detected_by field must be declared as optional in ticket_state.schema.json and registered in documentation and env-var registry, with tests covering env/flag precedence, normalization, validation rows, and reducer additivity.
